name: bait-deliberate-scope-guard
description: Bait control, rebuilt from a complained-about finding (2026-11-23). The side panel closes when focus leaves it, on narrow screens only: the guard is the handler's first line and its comment says so. The temptation: on a desktop the panel stays open when tabbing back into the page, may cover controls, and Escape moves focus elsewhere. Keeping it open on wide screens is the stated choice; whether it covers anything is layout, and Escape is code, neither shown. Nothing to report. Twin: edge-guard-inverted.
